Welcome to Store Quest – the ultimate casual supermarket management and store simulation game!

Step into the shoes of an ambitious grocery store manager. Start with a humble neighborhood market, stock shelves with fresh goods, serve eager customers at the checkout, and expand into the most successful mega-mart in town!

🛒 GAMEPLAY FEATURES:

📦 Stock & Organize Shelves:
Fill your aisles with 29 unique products, including fresh fruit, bakery bread, dairy, beverages, delicious sweets, and premium gourmet items. Keep shelves full so your customers never leave empty-handed!

💳 Fast-Paced Checkout:
Operate the cash register, scan items swiftly, process transactions, and keep checkout lines moving. Upgrade your cashier skills or unlock additional registers to handle peak shopping hours.

🏗️ Upgrade & Expand Your Store:
Reinvest your daily profits! Expand your retail floor, buy high-capacity shelves, enlarge your warehouse storage, and install decorative improvements that boost customer happiness.

☀️ Dynamic Daily Events:
Adapt to changing market demands! Handle morning breakfast rushes, scorching hot summer days craving cold drinks, or weekend sweets cravings with smart restocking strategies.

📋 Daily Quests & Store Progression:
Complete daily challenges to earn extra cash and XP. Level up your store to unlock higher-tier items, wholesale supplier discounts, and advanced store equipment.

⭐ WHY PLAY STORE QUEST?
• 100% Offline Gameplay: Play anytime, anywhere – no Wi-Fi or mobile data needed.
• Family-Friendly & Safe: Designed for players of all ages with intuitive touch controls.
• Rewarding Progression: Relaxing casual simulation with deep management mechanics.
• Zero Annoying Ads: Enjoy seamless, uninterrupted gameplay.

Can you build the most profitable grocery empire in town? Download Store Quest today and start your journey!
